entities.summary: Florence Ellen Arnold, better known as Florrie, is an English pop singer-songwriter, drummer and model. Closely associated with the Xenomania production house, since joining as their in-house drummer in 2008 she has played live and on record for popular artists such as Kylie Minogue, Girls Aloud and the Pet Shop Boys. Florrie was a composers & musicians from Bristol (b. 1988-12-28, Bristol). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
